dct_title_s: King County, Washington : water sampling sites
dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington water sampling locations from Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) database. Covers also portions of surrounding counties.

Purpose: This datalayer was derived from a point coverage representing the location of water quality sampling sites. The source coverage is generated weekly from the LIMS oracle database maintained by the King County DNR Environmental Lab. Each point has an attribute identifying its LIMS locator ID.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
